name: @holoscript/holosystem
description: Portable public-package bootstrap and inspection contract for HoloSystem consumers.

scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run smoke

publicConsumption.coreRule: Cold consumers create and inspect a HoloSystem configuration from public registry contracts and caller-owned bindings.
publicConsumption.localBoundary: Machine paths, credentials, private repositories, and operator state are caller inputs, never package defaults.
publicConsumption.supportBoundary: Configuration creation and static portability inspection are supported; installation, credential acquisition, service mutation, and publishing are outside this package.
